sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Classify the sum of the rational number 9 and the irrational number √6 as rational or irrational, and be ready to justify it.
Option A delivers 20 units of output over 5 hours. Option B delivers 33 units over 11 hours. Which has the greater output per hour?
choices: There is not enough information without knowing the total hours available.

items.prompt: A rectangular plot measures 57.9 m by 13.9 m, each measured to the nearest tenth of a metre. Report the area to 2 decimal places.
You are building a model of the population density of a county. Which unit should the modelled quantity be reported in?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: A delivery drone operates at 41 kilometers per hour. Express this rate in meters per minute.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Rewrite the index-4 radical expression 4√(x^8) using a rational exponent, in lowest terms.
